founders.summary: Jason Griffith is the founder of Undeniable Health AI Inc. (White Plains, NY), which builds AI 'digital employee' billing agents that work healthcare claims end to end, from charge entry through denials, appeals and AR follow-up, for providers and billing companies. The company has filed two Form Ds totaling $1.1M ($500K from 1 investor, then $600K from 13 investors). The founders are self-described repeat founders with exits, and there is one named customer testimonial (JAG Billing). It fits the fund's regulated-AI thesis on market and compliance positioning, but the founders' RCM depth is adjacent rather than from inside billing operations, there is no public or open-source traction, and nearly all claims are self-reported.
